intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene on chromosome Xp21.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: SPGFX3 is the OMIM name for X-linked MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia caused by CFAP47 mutations.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is a form of male infertility characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) (Liu et al., 2021). Affected men show reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology (Liu et al., 2021).

checks.claim: Men affected with SPGFX3 show reduced sperm motility.

checks.explanation: Asthenozoospermia denotes reduced sperm motility; mice also showed reduced motility.

checks.claim: Men affected with SPGFX3 show abnormal sperm flagellar morphology.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: MMAF = multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) studied 3 unrelated Chinese men with asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF), as well as a man from an Australian cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia. All of the men displayed typical MMAF phenotypes. Liu et al. (2021) suggested that the prognosis with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) was good.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF and identified 1 man with mutations in the CFAP47 gene. paragraphs.text: The transmission pattern of SPGFX3 is X-linked, as established by Liu et al. (2021), who found hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in affected men.

paragraphs.text: By whole-exome sequencing in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF, Liu et al. (2021) identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene. The 3 variants were absent from human control population genome databases and were predicted to be deleterious by multiple bioinformatic tools. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all 3 men. Analysis of whole-exome sequencing data from an additional cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia originating from Australia identified a man with a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene.

paragraphs.text: In 1 of 7 men with MMAF, Liao et al. (2022) identified 2 mutations in the CFAP47 gene, c.706G-A (V236M) and c.1337C-T (T446M). Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed dramatically reduced CFAP47 in spermatozoa from this man. Liao et al. (2022) also found that CFAP47 interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of spermatozoa and concluded that CFAP47 was necessary for WDR87 transport during sperm flagellar biogenesis.

paragraphs.text: In a man with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF), Liao et al. (2022) identified a c.706G-A transition in the CFAP47 gene, resulting in a val236-to-met (V236M) substitution, together with a second CFAP47 mutation (T446M). CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from this man.

agent.process_note: I read both papers in full, but each was available only as an abstract. Liu et al. (2021) is the main evidence: hemizygous CFAP47 missense variants in 3 Chinese men, an Xp21.1 deletion in an Australian man, and a mouse model. That abstract does not name the 3 missense variants, so I could not list them as allelic variants. Liao et al. (2022) gives 2 CFAP47 variants found in 1 man, but its abstract does not state their zygosity or how the 2 variants relate to each other on the X chromosome, so I did not call them hemizygous. No reference data was supplied, so no MIM number is given for CFAP47. The chromosome location (Xp21) comes from the Xp21.1 deletion reported by Liu et al. (2021).
